domains.label: AI & Machine Learning

specializations.label: MLOps & ML Platforms

specializations.label: Applied Science

specializations.label: Backend

specializations.label: Frontend

specializations.label: Full Stack

specializations.label: Mobile
specializations.description: Native or cross-platform mobile application development.

specializations.label: Distributed Systems

specializations.label: Developer Tools
specializations.description: Compilers, SDKs, IDEs, build tools, or developer productivity products.

domains.label: Data & Analytics
domains.description: Working with data pipelines, analysis, experimentation, and business intelligence.

specializations.label: General Data & Analytics
specializations.description: General data work without a clearer data specialization.

specializations.label: Data Engineering

specializations.label: Data Science

specializations.label: Analytics & BI
specializations.description: Business intelligence, reporting, metrics, dashboards, and descriptive analysis.

specializations.label: Experimentation
specializations.description: A/B testing, causal inference, experimental design, and measurement.

domains.label: Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps

specializations.label: Infrastructure Engineering

specializations.label: Cloud Platforms

specializations.label: DevOps & CI/CD
specializations.description: Build, release, deployment automation, and continuous delivery systems.

specializations.label: Site Reliability
specializations.description: Production reliability, observability, incident response, and service operations.

specializations.label: Networking
specializations.description: Network architecture, protocols, connectivity, traffic, and network operations.

domains.label: Cybersecurity

specializations.label: Security Engineering
specializations.description: General security engineering without a clearer security specialization.

specializations.label: Application Security

specializations.label: Information Security
specializations.description: Security governance, controls, risk, compliance, identity, or enterprise security operations.

specializations.label: Vulnerability Management
specializations.description: Finding, prioritizing, remediating, and tracking security vulnerabilities.

specializations.description: General electrical or computing hardware work without a clearer hardware specialization.

specializations.label: Analog Design

specializations.label: Digital Design

specializations.label: ASIC & VLSI

specializations.label: RF & Wireless

specializations.label: Power Electronics

specializations.label: Hardware Verification

specializations.label: Firmware

specializations.label: Device Drivers

specializations.label: Real-Time Systems

specializations.label: Scientific Computing

domains.label: Product Management
